description: This file defines a logging utility class 'Log' for the AWS CRT PHP SDK, providing static methods to configure logging output and levels, and to write log messages.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging configuration and message output.

methods.name: toStdout
methods.description: Configures logging output to standard output.

methods.name: toStderr
methods.description: Configures logging output to standard error.

methods.name: toFile
methods.description: Configures logging output to a specified file.

methods.name: toStream
methods.description: Configures logging output to a specified stream resource.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the minimum log level for output.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level.
